description: Header file defining the NetworkDelegateImpl class, which implements the NetworkDelegate interface for handling network request events and policies in Chromium's networking code.

classes.name: NetworkDelegateImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the NetworkDelegate interface handling network request lifecycle events and policies.

methods.name: OnBeforeURLRequest
methods.description: Called before a URL request is initiated, allowing modification or cancellation.

methods.name: OnBeforeStartTransaction
methods.description: Called before starting a transaction, allowing modification of request headers.

methods.name: OnHeadersReceived
methods.description: Called when response headers are received, allowing override or inspection.

methods.name: OnBeforeRedirect
methods.description: Called before a redirect occurs, allowing inspection or modification.

methods.name: OnResponseStarted
methods.description: Called when a response has started.

methods.name: OnCompleted
methods.description: Called when a request has completed.

methods.name: OnURLRequestDestroyed
methods.description: Called when a URLRequest object is destroyed.

methods.name: OnAnnotateAndMoveUserBlockedCookies
methods.description: Annotates and moves user-blocked cookies based on first-party set metadata.

methods.name: OnCanSetCookie
methods.description: Determines if a cookie can be set for a request.

methods.name: OnForcePrivacyMode
methods.description: Determines privacy mode for a request.

methods.name: OnCancelURLRequestWithPolicyViolatingReferrerHeader
methods.description: Handles requests with referrer headers violating policy.

methods.name: OnCanQueueReportingReport
methods.description: Checks if a reporting report can be queued for an origin.

methods.name: OnCanSendReportingReports
methods.description: Determines if reporting reports can be sent to origins.

methods.name: OnCanSetReportingClient
methods.description: Checks if a reporting client can be set for an origin.

methods.name: OnCanUseReportingClient
methods.description: Checks if a reporting client can be used for an origin.

methods.name: OnGetFirstPartySetsCacheFilterMatchInfoMaybeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves cache filter match info for first-party sets.
